title: ATHENA complete engineering freeze
change_rule: Architecture changes require evidence, tests, an explicit proposal, and human approval.

source_reconciliation.limitation: The complete source conversation export is not stored in this public repository. Unspecified details remain unresolved and must not be invented.

evidence_register.record: The ATHENA architecture is fixed to seven layers: Knowledge, Evidence, Research, Market Intelligence, Decision Engine, Execution Engine, and Validation Engine.

ATHENA is institutional-grade and asset-agnostic; evidence precedes implementation; no Pine implementation before experiments are specified; scale targets are at least 100 papers, 250 experiments, 50 factors, 20 indicators, and 5 strategies.
Raw ATR is rejected because it is instrument-dependent; ATR percentile is required. GARCH is deferred because it cannot be faithfully reproduced in Pine Script.
ATHENA must operate continuously as a self-improving quantitative research organization that discovers repeatable market mechanics and converts evidence into trading decisions.
The 24/7 engineering and research operating model is frozen; subsequent architecture changes require evidence rather than preference.

The frozen runtime uses GitHub, an Ubuntu VPS, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO or S3, an orchestrator, specialist services, OpenAI API workers, market-data and eventual broker interfaces, Mission Control, and an Operations Director.
ChatGPT Work is the permanent ATHENA engineering headquarters.
The complete engineering freeze discussed in 8. Trading interfaces - Athena Daily Progress must be integrated into the repository.
Google Drive is the authoritative ATHENA research-document repository; Google Sheets control the evidence database, experiment tracker, and research dashboard; Google Docs hold living Research Cards.

The fixed research pipeline runs from paper through hypothesis, mathematical model, Pine, backtest, walk-forward, Monte Carlo, cross-market validation, and accept or reject; metrics include profit, risk-adjusted performance, drawdown, expectancy, win rate, average trade, and exposure.

Market Intelligence contains Volatility, Trend, Momentum, Liquidity, and Market State or Regime; Decision contains Probability, Confidence, and Strategy Selection; Execution contains Entry, Position Sizing, and Trade Management; Validation contains walk-forward, Monte Carlo, cross-market, and robustness analysis.
ATHENA Daily Progress runs at approximately 08:00 South African time and reports completion, research, experiments, decisions, risks, and milestones.

Decision capabilities include Market State, Strategy Selector, Risk Manager, Evidence Engine, Trade Reviewer, Market Memory, and Skeptic; the Skeptic blocks unsupported, overfit, and material event-risk trades.

ATHENA Market Data Resolution 1 approves Twelve Data Basic for internal non-commercial research; EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, SPY, QQQ, GLD, BTC/USD, and ETH/USD; 5-minute, 15-minute, 1-hour, 4-hour, and daily bars; daily history from 2010 or inception and intraday history from 2020; UTC normalization with retained source metadata; content fingerprints and fail-closed quarantine; a USD 0 initial budget and no upgrade above USD 79 per month without separate evidence and approval; no redistribution and no live execution.

ATHENA Runtime Persistence Resolution 1 approves PostgreSQL as canonical operational state, private S3-compatible content-addressed object storage for immutable runtime bytes, Redis for transient coordination only, encrypted off-site backups, a 60-minute RPO, a 240-minute RTO, closed schemas, migrations, integrity and restore tests, Docker development infrastructure, no repository credentials, no production-readiness claim without observed restore evidence, and no live execution.

mission.statement: Continuously discover repeatable market mechanics, convert evidence into governed trading decisions, learn from completed work and trades, and report operational state without bypassing the Decision Court.

layers.name: Knowledge
layers.purpose: Acquire and preserve research sources, Research Cards, bibliography, and permanent learning.

layers.name: Evidence
layers.purpose: Control variables, hypotheses, formulas, evidence links, provenance, and research questions.

layers.name: Research
layers.purpose: Turn evidence into falsifiable mathematical models and one-variable experiment specifications.

layers.name: Market Intelligence
layers.purpose: Measure volatility, trend, momentum, liquidity, market state, and regime on a normalized basis.

layers.name: Decision Engine
layers.purpose: Apply probability, confidence, strategy selection, risk, Skeptic review, and the Decision Court.

layers.name: Execution Engine
layers.purpose: Control entry logic, position sizing, trade management, and the boundary between research, paper, and eventual live execution.

layers.name: Validation Engine
layers.purpose: Run walk-forward, Monte Carlo, cross-market, sensitivity, and robustness analysis and reject any failed candidate.

rules: Pine work starts only after the experiment is specified.
Experiments isolate one variable before optimization.
Failure at any required validation stage rejects the candidate.
Win rate is a secondary metric; it cannot establish an edge by itself.

validation.promotion_rule: All required stages must pass; failure at any stage means rejection.
validation.numeric_threshold_status: not fully specified in recovered freeze

constraints: Raw ATR is prohibited as an asset-agnostic score.
GARCH remains deferred until a faithful Pine-compatible implementation exists.

baseline_scores.status: research baseline requiring validation, not an approved trading policy

approved_market_data.upgrade_authority: Separate evidence and Owner/CIO approval required
approved_market_data.quality_failure: quarantine; no fabricated bars; no research or Court use

skeptic_rule: The Skeptic blocks unsupported, overfit, or material event-risk recommendations.

runtime.execution_model: The platform schedules software agents and invokes GPT through an API as a bounded reasoning worker. ChatGPT is not the continuous runtime.
